messages:
Maya: Okay team — we just closed the 10M ARR milestone and shipped our first cross-region Dedicated customer! :tada: :champagne:
Samir: WHAT. This is incredible 🚀
Maya: They've been live for ~2 hours, failovers exercised, p95 latency holding under 120ms. Huge props to eng-runtime & eng-platform.
Omar: Shoutout to @devex for that onboarding checklist — saved us a ton of back-and-forth 🙌
Zane: I'm bringing ginger cake to the office at 3pm to celebrate 🍰
Tess: I'll be there. Mini-sparklers for the cake? :sparkler:
Lina: Photos or it didn't happen :camera_flash:
deploy-bot: deploy #prod-dedicated-1 finished successfully (sha: `8c7e2f`). Uptime checks: PASS :white_check_mark:
Karen: Love this. Also — anyone want a sticker sheet? I can send extras to remote folks.
Samir: Kazoos + tiny gong incoming 🥁
Maya: Also putting a quick spotlight on this in all-hands tomorrow. If you have one-liners about the win, DM me please :memo:
Tess: DM sent! Super proud of everyone ❤️
Zane: Sticker request submitted. Also can someone water the office plants before the cake? I will forget. :seedling:
Lina: Quick poll for remote cake delivery: react with :one: for ginger, :two: for chocolate. I'll tally in 20m.
Maya: Thank you all — could not ask for a more relentless and kind team. Onwards to the next 10M. :rocket:
